The '''2017 Copa Sudamericana second stage''' was played from 27 June to 9 August 2017.<ref name="dates">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-conmebol-dio-conocer-los-calendarios-oficiales-de-las-copas-bridgestone-libertadores-y|title=La CONMEBOL dio a conocer los calendarios oficiales de las copas Bridgestone Libertadores y Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=21 December 2016}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/conmebol_sudamericana_2017_-_reglamento_28_02_17.pdf|title=Reglamento Conmebol Sudamericana 2017|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the second stage was held on 14 June 2017, 20:00 PYT ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="draw20170614">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/se-conocen-los-emparejamientos-de-la-segunda-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana|title=Se conocen los emparejamientos de la Segunda Fase de la CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=14 June 2017}}</ref> For the second stage, the teams were allocated to two pots according to their previous results in this season:
*'''Pot 1:''' 10 teams transferred from the Copa Libertadores and six best winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana
*'''Pot 2:''' 16 remaining winners of the first stage from the Copa Sudamericana

The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties (O1–O16) between a team from Pot 1 and a team from Pot 2, with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association could be drawn into the same tie.<ref name="procedure20170614">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-sudamericana-el-miercoles-14-junio-se-sortea-la-segunda-fase|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA: se sortea la Segunda Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=14 June 2017}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the second stage, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] would be used. If still tied, [[extra time (association football)|extra time]] would not be played, and the [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 6.1).<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the second stage advanced to the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2017 Copa Sudamericana final stages|knockout stages]].<section end=Format />

==Matches==
The first legs were played on 27–29 June, 5–6 and 11–13 July, and the second legs were played on 25–27 July, 1–3 and 9 August 2017.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/conmebol-sudamericana-confirmados-los-horarios-y-fechas-de-la-segunda-fase|title=CONMEBOL Sudamericana: Confirmados los horarios y fechas de la Segunda Fase|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=16 June 2017}}</ref>
